nav.title: Povho yeKufambiswa neAI
nav.subtitle: Ibhazi remitauro miviri inotungamirwa kune vanhu.

customer.title: Tanga hurukuro
customer.consentText: Ndinobvuma kuti hurukuro iyi inogona kugadzirwa nemupi weAI akaiswa. Zvinyorwa zvinovharirwa usati wachengetedzwa.
customer.setupHint: Haipo kusvika muenzi ane kiyi yekuvhara nemupi weAI aisa.
customer.chatEmpty: Matauriro ako acharatidzwa pano. Zviito zveAI zvicha shanduka chete; hakuna kubhadhara, kuchinja account, kudzosera kana kutumira kunoitwa.
customer.voiceStreamNote: Izwi rebrowza rinotumirwa nenzira yekuyerera kumupi akagadziriswa; OpsCore haitaure kuti inochengetedza ruzha rusina kugadziriswa.
customer.voiceRequirement: Izwi rebrowza rinoda HTTPS (kana localhost), maikorofoni, mvumo, modhi yeRealtime yakagadziriswa nekiyi yemupi. Haisi bhiriji yefoni yePSTN/SIP.

queue.title: Mhera yekusimudza
queue.description: Hurukuro dzengozi yakakura, dzisina kugadziriswa kana dzichida munhu dzinoonekwa pano. Chinhu mumhera zvinoreva kuvhunzwa, hauna kubatana.
queue.empty: Hapana kuendesa kune vanhu kwiri kufamba kune iyi sangano.
queue.replyStorageNote: Mhinduro dzevanhu dzinoiswa mukodhi pakuchengetwa uye dzinoonekwa mukunyorwa kwenhaurirano.

boundaries.title: Miganhu yebasa
boundaries.automateBody: Mhindu dzekutanga dzemitauro miviri, kujekesa, kugovanisa zvinangwa nengozi, kuchengetedza zvinyorwa zvakanaka, kugadzira mhera nekupa vashandi.
boundaries.humanBody: Kumbiro kwechokwadi kwemunhu, kuvimba shoma, ngozi hombe yakanangana, mutemo usipo, nyaya isina kugadzirwa, kuchema kwemvura yepachena/kudzivirira kana chiito chisingazivikanwe.
boundaries.notEnabledBody: Kufambisa PSTN/SIP/WhatsApp/imeeri, bridhi yefoni inofamba, kuona kwezvinhu zveCRM nezvokuti mitauro yakanaka zvinoda adapter yemupi wechokwadi, zvinodiwa uye bvunzo dzekugamuchirwa.

messages.qualificationNotice: Hapana mutauro unogona kushandiswa pakuambirana kusvika mabvunzo ezvinyorwa, ASR, TTS, matauriro nekudzokorora apfuraidza.
messages.configOk: Kugadzirisa kwapo. Kuisirwa kwemupi uye hunyanzvi hwemitauro hunoda zvokwadi mabvunzo ekugamuchirwa.
messages.conversationCreated: Hurukuro yakachengetedzwa yakasikwa. Hunyanzvi hwemitauro hauna kuwana kugona kweboka.
messages.handoffQueued: Kuendesa kumunhu kwaiswa mumhera ({reason}). Iyi ndiro yekumbira mhera, hauna kubatana kwechokwadi.
messages.aiResponseFailed: Mhindu yeAI haina kupedza. Hakuna chiito chaitwa. Unogona kumbira mumwe munhu anoshanda.
messages.apiUnavailable: API yeContact Center haina kutakurwa. Pinda mukonzoro yeOpsCore, zvino tora peji iri zvakare.
messages.handoffQueuedQueueOnly: Kuendeswa kumunhu kwaiswa mumutsetse ({reason}). Mutsetse hauratidzi kuti mumiriri akabatana.
messages.voiceHandoffStopped: Kuendeswa kumunhu kwaiswa mumutsetse. Chikamu cheAI chebrowza chiri kumira; kutamisa runhare rwakananga hakuna kugadziriswa.
messages.voiceRealtimeError: Mupi wenguva chaiyo akashumira kukanganisa. Mira chikamu chezwi woedza zvakare mushure mekuongorora kugadzirisa kwemupi.
messages.voiceActive: Chikamu chezwi chiri kushanda. Dzvanya “Kumbira mumwe munhu” chero nguva; izvi zvinogadzira chinhu mumutsetse, kwete kutamisa kwePSTN.

errors.CONTACT_CENTER_REALTIME_CONNECT_FAILED: Mupi wezwi renguva chaiyo haana kuwanikwa.
errors.BROWSER_REALTIME_VOICE_UNSUPPORTED: Brauzi iyi haitsigire izwi renguva chaiyo.
